messages.subject: W15 dt ladder executed: all 3 cells aborted, each by a different engine mechanism
messages.body: Ran the W15 dt-ladder protocol end to end in my worktree: PREREG.md timestamped 22:34 before the first launch, three params files differing from W10 dt2e6 by exactly {timestep_s, render_timeline_path}, then cells 10us -> 100us -> 1ms one at a time under wall caps (5400/3600/3600 s), no retries, with launch/terminal receipts, and an analysis that recomputes every number from the cells' own timeline/NPZ/JSON. All three cells aborted with rc 134 but by three different mechanisms: 10us reproduced the W10 engine error_out_vel divergence yet only after running essentially the whole protocol (2790 syncs, last sim_t 3.1533 s in reclose, both door stops pinch_guard, max saved speed 19.2243 m/s just under the 20 m/s pop-stop, engine then saw 2.17e9 m/s between saved syncs; W10 had died at 2.56118 s mid-close), while 100us died in settle after 40 s on a GPU out-of-memory assertion and 1ms died in settle after 10 s on a DEMCubContactDetection.cu:168 kernel assertion - so the B cells never reached any physics decision and produced no timeline, capture, lip gap or heightmap at all. Measured actual sync durations confirm the plan's float32-accumulation table to ~1e-10 s (10us: 0.1 ms request realised as 0.110 ms = 1.100x, 1 ms as 1.010x, 4 ms as 1.0025x), no RRD was baked because no cell completed (omission reason and preserved event dumps recorded in inspection.json, with both generated PNGs actually viewed), and REPORT_w15.md states no pass line, calls no dt converged or safe, and flags that the B-cell contact-margin mechanism is a hypothesis needing GetUpdateFreq/GetExpandFactor logging (a code change, so not done) and that the 100us OOM is not separable from this card's 12.2/16.4 GB headroom - both are your call, as is any rerun, since automatic retry was forbidden.
